name: Oh No, It's Monday!
source:
In a company where having a second job is strictly forbidden, the MC keeps her idol life hidden at all costs. Her plan is simple: endure until winter ends, resign after Christmas, and debut as a full-time idol without ever being exposed.

But just as the countdown begins, the impossible happens— two of her fans appear inside the company.

With every interaction threatening to reveal her secret, the MC must navigate work, lies, and dangerous closeness before Christmas arrives.

Will she make it to her escape date… or will her hidden stage be exposed first?

[From [url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/oh-no-its-monday]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在严禁兼职的公司里，MC不惜一切代价隐藏自己的偶像生活。她的计划很简单：熬到冬天结束，圣诞节后辞职，以全职偶像身份出道，不暴露。

但就在倒计时开始时，不可能的事情发生了——她的两名粉丝出现在公司内部。

每一次互动都有可能泄露她的秘密，主持人必须在圣诞节到来之前应对工作、谎言和危险的亲密关系。

她会成功完成逃亡约会吗……还是她隐藏的舞台会先暴露出来？

[来自[url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/oh-no-its-monday]itch.io[/url]]
